answer_1.quote: we propose a prompt-based controllable contrastive generation (Con2GEN) algorithm to disambiguate biomedical entities across diverse languages.
answer_1.outputs: Con2GEN generates entity identifiers following a predefined natural language template by filling fixed slots such as [Ent Name], [Ent Type], and [Ent Lang].

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we report Accuracy for evaluating the performance of the proposed model against the baseline models following the previous work.
